resources.string: Answers use eligible evidence in this scope. Quarantined, deleted and no-AI sources are excluded. Reports describe their recorded time.
Ask a question about the archived evidence. Saved answers require a connection to check current access.
This request is saved, but its result is not confirmed. Check for updates to recover the same question. A retry uses the same request identity.
Answering. Processing has started and may incur cost.
Processing may already have started. Cancellation cannot undo that processing or its cost. Check for the final result.
The processing outcome is uncertain. This question will not be sent again automatically. Check for updates; a new question may incur additional processing.
The question could not be answered. No answer is available.
This answer was removed because its evidence was deleted.
This answer is unavailable because its evidence can no longer be read.
Reported observation — check the source time
These suggestions have no authority to act. Any action needs its own exact review.
This is the retained excerpt checked just now. Open the source for its date and context; it does not establish a current service state.
The cited excerpt could not be verified. Its evidence may be deleted, restricted, or temporarily unavailable.
Sign in again to check saved chat and evidence.
This scope or saved chat is unavailable. Deleted or quarantined evidence cannot be used for chat.
Chat could not be checked. Saved requests remain on this phone. Check for updates when connected.
The chat draft or request could not be saved. Check storage and try again before leaving this screen.
Waiting for an eligible device. Local-only evidence is not sent to a cloud model.
Cloud processing is blocked by the spending allowance or unverified rates. Waiting for an eligible device.
Cloud processing is unavailable. Waiting for an eligible device.
Enter a question of 1 to 4,000 characters.
